description: Scientific and GIS provenance for preliminary Marswalk science stops and annotated routing edges.
scientificLimitations: POI locations and route corridors are project annotations, not NASA mission plans.
A source link establishes dataset provenance, not a scientific proof of the terrain interpretation.
15 degrees is a prototype threshold, not an official NASA EVA safety limit.
Some team handoff files referenced by network.json are not committed to this repository; check their availability before independently reproducing route construction.

HIRISE_ORTHO.title: HiRISE orthophoto — Athabasca Valles Distributary Channel
HIRISE_ORTHO.role: Image evidence for preliminary local observations; not proof of composition, route traversability or approved POI positions.

HIRISE_DTM.title: HiRISE stereo Digital Terrain Model — Athabasca Valles Distributary Channel
HIRISE_DTM.role: Terrain elevation source. Local crop and its pixel-level processing are team-derived.

HIRISE_SLOPE.title: Terrain slope in degrees, derived from HiRISE DTM
HIRISE_SLOPE.role: Project-calculated slope; not an independent NASA hazard or astronaut-safety classification.

T028_REPORT.title: Candidate corridor verification and raster calculations
T028_REPORT.role: Internal numerical routing evidence; not a public NASA source.

T028_P04_MEAN_CSV.title: P04 shorter mean-slope alternative candidate
T028_P04_MEAN_CSV.role: Internal path-construction input; not an enabled or approved traverse.
